summary: You present a relevant Australian reef-monitoring concept, explain why one spacecraft could serve the mission, and support the design with useful STK imagery and access data. To move the overall work forward, strengthen technical evidence for launch, orbit, communications and end-of-life choices, then draw more specific conclusions and polish referencing and presentation.
next_steps: Make the launch plan verifiable: support Vega E availability and a compatible 600 km sun-synchronous injection with evidence, or assess a feasible alternative and explain any required manoeuvres.

Make the orbit and communications reproducible: clarify the orbital elements and epoch, distinguish RAAN from launch latitude, and support access claims with station geometry, elevation mask and link/data-volume analysis.

Engineer and document disposal, including drag-sail area, spacecraft mass, predicted decay time and applicable debris guidance; replace Wikipedia with complete authoritative references and use your findings to develop specific conclusions.

criteria.C1: Your Introduction explains the reef-monitoring purpose, environmental rationale and choice of one spacecraft, and identifies potential agency users. To strengthen this accomplished work, distinguish the spacecraft operator from customer/user agencies and specify their roles and needs.
criteria.C2: Your Launch, Orbit, Ground Control & Communications, and Mission Duration & EOL sections, supported by STK imagery and access data, cover many design elements. For the accomplished level, substantiate launcher and injection feasibility, correct the RAAN and access rationale, document manoeuvres, and quantify communications and disposal; include relevant software files.
criteria.C3: Your Conclusion recaps the main design choices and acknowledges uncertainty about the launcher. To reach the accomplished level, draw explicit conclusions from your analyses, explain what the access and orbit results mean for mission performance, and identify how unresolved feasibility and disposal issues affect confidence in the design.
criteria.C4: Your report has a recognizable structure, executive summary, figures, tables and bibliography. For the accomplished level, make figure and table presentation consistent, correct grammar and wording, and ensure citations are complete and consistent; replace the Wikipedia entry with appropriate authoritative sources.
